list.label: caprock pty-host
list.why: A terminal holder no Caprock can reattach to; claude still runs in it, so it is never stopped on its own. Stopping it closes its terminal. Its data directory is gone.

list.label: claude
list.why: A claude whose session ended (last heard from 25h ago), still running with no terminal.

list.label: node index.js
list.why: An MCP server whose parent has exited (usually the claude that started it), with no terminal.

verdicts.text: 1 other Caprock daemon running beside this one (pid 9214 /opt/homebrew/bin/caprock, data /tmp/stand), using 33 MB. Caprock never stops another daemon on its own; stop the ones you do not use (the doctor's Clean up can).

11 of 26 terminal holders are orphans no Caprock will reattach to (all of them together use 260 MB). 11 hold only an idle shell or nothing: the daemon stops them on its own within 10 minutes (the Stop button in Settings does it now).
2 processes look abandoned: 1 claude, 1 MCP server. Caprock never stops them on its own; the doctor's Clean up or `caprock doctor --stop <pid>` can.
The daemon read 1.6 GB from disk in the last 60 minutes (over 500 MB).

11 terminal holders run from another Caprock install or an older version (9 from /opt/homebrew/bin/caprock, 2 from /Applications/Caprock 0.104.app/Contents/MacOS/caprock). 11 of them are orphans (above).

actions.what: folded the 290 MB write-ahead log back into the database (now 2.0 GB)
stopped 3 orphaned terminal holders (3 holding only an idle shell)
